sourceTitle: Cattle and Their Diseases Embracing Their History and Breeds, Crossing and Breeding, and Feeding and Management; with the Diseases to Which They Are Subject, and the Remedies Best Adapted to Their Cure
description: "Cattle and Their Diseases" by Robert Jennings is a scientific publication written in the mid-19th century. This comprehensive work explores various aspects of cattle, including their history, breeds, breeding practices, feeding, management, and the diseases they are prone to, along with the remedies for those ailments.
